<!-- en -->
v0.1.8 is a feature release: the local dashboard arrives — `serve` starts a read-only HTTP server with an embedded, client-rendered dashboard, manageable in the background nginx-style — the `report` bundle gains a self-contained interactive HTML page, `watch`/`export`/`compare` align with the `query` view system, `top`/`forecast` gain JSON output, version display is normalized for local builds, and session-title collection is fixed for Codex, Claude, and AutoClaw.

### Highlights
- New `serve` command family: a read-only local HTTP server (default `127.0.0.1:8619`) serving an embedded dark dashboard — client-rendered charts, a 7×24 heat matrix, a compare panel with a daily curve, a forecast panel, and sortable tables with one-click CSV export — plus nginx-style background management via `serve start`/`status`/`stop`/`restart` under a strict single-instance contract.
- `watch`, `export`, and `compare` align with the `query` view system: a `watch` frame is now the full `query` output for any built-in or configured view (previously a fixed model-grouped summary), `export` supports configured subqueries/groups and the default view, and `compare` accepts two positional periods. `top` and `forecast` gain `--format json`.
- Session titles are collected for Codex, Claude, and AutoClaw: the Title column in `query session`, `top`, and the reports is no longer empty for these clients.

### New
- `serve` — the local dashboard. Starts a read-only local HTTP server (default `127.0.0.1:8619`; `--addr` to change it, `--open` to launch the browser, Ctrl+C to stop) serving an embedded single-page dashboard: dark, monospaced, bilingual, zero external resources. KPI cards carry delta chips against the baseline window (the requests, total, and cache-hit cards appear only when the configured output columns include them), and a metric strip renders the token-kind columns of the configured `[query.output] columns` layout (input / output / cache read / reasoning with the default layout; a cache-create column appears when the layout includes it). Five fixed token-kind colours run through the composition strip and every chart. All charts render client-side from integer rows: stacked per-day bars (click a day or month bar to focus that range; beyond 92 days the day bars roll up to ISO weeks with drill-down disabled), per-hour/weekday/month single-series bars, four-per-row donut share charts, and the 7×24 weekday-by-hour heat matrix with row and column totals. A full-width compare row pairs a current-vs-base daily curve with the metric table, and a full-width forecast row mirrors the `forecast` command. Top sessions and the eight per-dimension tables are sortable, each with one-click CSV export (current row order, exact integers, UTF-8 BOM). Range presets plus custom `from`/`to` default to Today and are remembered across reloads; auto-refresh runs off/10s/30s/60s (default 30s) with a cached-payload first paint and silent background refresh. A single-day range adapts: it hides the comparison table and shows only the hour chart, while the delta chips still compare against the previous day. The HTTP data surface is strictly read-only (no CORS headers, no database or configuration writes), and all data for one request shares a single read snapshot.
- `serve start` / `serve status` / `serve stop` / `serve restart` — background runs, nginx-style. `serve start` spawns a detached child and returns once it reports ready (idempotent with exit 0 when the recorded instance still answers on `/api/meta`); `serve status` inspects it; `serve stop` judges success solely by the probe going down (SIGTERM with a 3s graceful window and a SIGKILL fallback on Unix, `taskkill /F` on Windows) and never reports success while the server still answers — if a new instance takes over mid-stop, the stop is routed to the new instance; `serve restart` stops any running instance (a foreground Ctrl+C session included) and leaves a fresh background one. State lives in `serve.json` (removed on graceful stop; stale or corrupt state is cleaned by a conditional delete under a state lock, so a fresh instance's state is never removed) and background output goes to `serve.log`. At most one dashboard instance (foreground or background) runs at any time: a second `serve`, in either form and regardless of the requested address, is rejected before listening, printing the running instance's URL and PID and exiting 0 idempotently.
- `report` gains `index.html`. The bundle's twelfth file is a self-contained interactive bilingual report page with zero external resources — it opens offline with a double click and is the browsing entry point of the bundle: KPI overview, the two-period comparison, all embedded charts, top sessions, sortable per-dimension tables with one-click CSV export, and anchor navigation.
- `chart` and `report` SVG charts switch to the dark theme of the dashboard's design language: bars, lines, pies, and the heat matrix (11-step deep-blue-to-cyan scale) all render on a dark ground.
- `watch` now shows the full `query` output. The frame body is exactly the query output — statistics header, view tables with the configured output columns and provider aliases, and collection-error warnings. `--by` accepts every built-in view (`client`, `model`, `provider`, `project`, `day`, `month`, `hour`, `weekday`, `heatmap`, `session`, `summary`) or a configured view name from `query.subqueries`/`query.groups`; with no `--by` the default view runs (`query.default`, built-in fallback `client`). Previously the frame was a fixed grouping summary with `--by` limited to four dimensions (default `model`). Interval refresh, midnight rollover for the current day, and `--once` keep their semantics.
- `export` supports configured views. With no view argument, the default view is exported (`query.default`, built-in fallback `client`). A configured subquery exports one row per dimension combination with one key column per dimension; a configured group exports its member views as CSV sections in declaration order separated by blank lines, or as a JSON object mapping member names to their row arrays. `summary` and `heatmap` still have no row schema and are not exportable; an unknown view is rejected with the dynamic allowed set (built-in views plus configured names).
- `compare 202607 202608`. Two positional periods are compared chronologically — the earlier one is the baseline and argument order does not matter — and a year is accepted as one of the two periods. Two positional periods cannot be combined with `--base` (the baseline would be fixed twice).
- `top --format json` and `forecast --format json`. Both align with the `export` JSON contract: raw integers, two-space indentation, a trailing newline. A `top` record carries `rank`, the raw source values `client`/`project`/`title`, `first_ts`/`last_ts` as Unix-millisecond timestamps with `duration_ms`, and all seven metrics (`requests`, `fresh_input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_create`, `reasoning`, `total`); `forecast` carries `today_so_far`, the two look-back `windows`, and `projections` (a window with no data contributes no projection; with no data at all, `projections` is `[]`).
- Normalized version display. A local build or `go install` pseudo-version displays as `vX.Y.Z-dev` (the base version indicates the release the checkout is heading toward; the `commit` line keeps the exact revision), `build_time` renders in the local timezone, and `update --force` accepts the normalized dev display in addition to the literal `dev`. The normalized dev form requires a semantically valid base version — a string that fails to parse is never mistaken for a dev build.

### Fixed
- Codex session titles. Codex App and CLI sessions previously always had an empty Title: the title source is the Codex state DB (`threads.title`), and an upsert carrying an empty title no longer overwrites an existing one. Existing sessions backfill with one `token-usage collect all`.
- Claude session titles. The JSONL custom-title payload field had drifted to camelCase (`customTitle`) while the collector only read the old kebab form, so the title never parsed; both forms are now normalized (camelCase wins when both appear; within one file the last non-empty value wins). Backfill likewise with `collect all`; sessions whose source file contains no title line stay empty.
- AutoClaw session titles. A three-tier fallback now derives titles: the client's LocalStorage display name (read-only LevelDB access, bridged via sessions.json), the cron session `label`, then a title derived from the session's first valid user message. AutoClaw sessions backfill automatically on the next daemon restart.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

v0.1.8 是一个功能版本：本地仪表板到位——`serve` 启动内嵌客户端渲染仪表板的只读 HTTP 服务，并可用 nginx 风格后台管理——`report` 报告包新增自包含交互式 HTML 页面，`watch`/`export`/`compare` 与 query 视图体系对齐，`top`/`forecast` 新增 JSON 输出，本地构建版本显示归一，并修复 Codex、Claude 与 AutoClaw 的会话标题采集。

### 亮点
- 新增 `serve` 命令族：只读本地 HTTP 服务（默认 `127.0.0.1:8619`）提供内嵌深色仪表板——客户端自绘图表、7×24 热力矩阵、带逐日曲线的对比面板、预估面板、可排序表格与一键 CSV 导出——并以 `serve start`/`status`/`stop`/`restart` 按 nginx 风格后台管理，受严格单实例契约约束。
- `watch`、`export`、`compare` 与 query 视图体系对齐：`watch` 帧表现在是任意内置或已配置视图的完整 `query` 输出（此前是固定的按模型分组摘要），`export` 支持已配置子查询/组合与默认视图，`compare` 接受双位置参数。`top` 与 `forecast` 新增 `--format json`。
- Codex、Claude、AutoClaw 的会话标题开始采集：`query session`、`top` 与报告中的 Title 列对这些客户端不再为空。

### 新增
- `serve`——本地仪表板。启动只读本地 HTTP 服务（默认 `127.0.0.1:8619`；`--addr` 改地址、`--open` 打开浏览器、Ctrl+C 停止），提供内嵌单页仪表板：深色、全等宽、双语、零外部资源。KPI 卡带对基线窗口的增减 chips（requests、total、Cache Hit 三卡仅在配置输出列包含它们时展示），指标条按 `[query.output] columns` 配置渲染 token 类别列（默认布局为 input / output / cache read / reasoning；配置含 cache create 列时同步出现）。五类 token 固定识别色贯穿构成条带与全部图表。所有图表由整数行在客户端自绘：按天堆叠柱（点击日/月柱聚焦该范围；超过 92 天按 ISO 周聚合并禁用钻取）、按小时/星期/月单色柱、一行四张的环形占比图、带行列合计的 7×24 星期×小时热力矩阵。通栏对比行将当前 vs 基线逐日曲线与指标表并排，通栏预估行镜像 `forecast` 命令口径。Top sessions 与八个维度明细表可排序，逐表一键 CSV 导出（当前行序、精确整数、UTF-8 BOM）。范围预设加自定义 `from`/`to` 默认 Today 且跨刷新记忆；自动刷新支持 关/10s/30s/60s（默认 30s），首屏用上次载荷立即渲染、后台静默刷新。单日范围自适应：隐藏对比表、只显示按小时图，增减 chips 仍与前一日在对比。HTTP 数据面严格只读（无 CORS 头、不写数据库与配置），单次请求的全部数据取自同一读事务快照。
- `serve start` / `serve status` / `serve stop` / `serve restart`——nginx 风格后台运行。`serve start` 拉起分离子进程并在其就绪后返回（记录的实例仍在 `/api/meta` 应答时幂等退出 0）；`serve status` 查看状态；`serve stop` 仅以探活下线判成功（Unix 上 SIGTERM 3 秒优雅窗 + SIGKILL 兜底，Windows 用 `taskkill /F`），服务仍应答时绝不谎报成功——stop 进行中新实例接管时，停止动作重路由到新实例；`serve restart` 停掉运行中的实例（含前台 Ctrl+C 会话）并以全新后台实例接管。状态记于 `serve.json`（优雅停止时删除；陈旧或损坏状态在状态锁内条件删除，新实例的状态绝不会被误删），后台输出写入 `serve.log`。任意时刻至多一个仪表板实例（前台或后台）在运行：第二个 `serve`——无论形态、无论请求哪个地址——都会在监听之前被拒绝，打印运行中实例的 URL 与 PID 并以退出码 0 幂等返回。
- `report` 新增 `index.html`。报告包的第 12 个文件是零外部资源的自包含双语交互报告页——离线双击即看，是整个报告包的浏览入口：KPI 概览、两期对比、全部内嵌图表、top sessions、可排序的维度明细表与一键 CSV 导出、锚点导航。
- `chart` 与 `report` 的 SVG 图表切换为仪表板设计语言的深色主题：柱状、折线、饼图与热力矩阵（11 级深蓝到浅青色阶）均在深色底上渲染。
- `watch` 显示完整 `query` 输出。帧体与 query 输出完全一致——统计信息区、应用输出列布局与 provider 别名的视图表、采集异常警告。`--by` 接受全部内置视图（`client`、`model`、`provider`、`project`、`day`、`month`、`hour`、`weekday`、`heatmap`、`session`、`summary`）或 `query.subqueries`/`query.groups` 中已配置的视图名；不带 `--by` 时执行默认视图（`query.default`，内置回退 `client`）。此前帧体是 `--by` 仅限四个维度的固定分组摘要（默认 `model`）。定间隔刷新、当日跨午夜自动切日与 `--once` 语义不变。
- `export` 支持已配置视图。不带视图参数时导出默认视图（`query.default`，内置回退 `client`）。已配置子查询按维度组合逐行导出、每个维度一列键列；已配置组合导出成员视图——CSV 按声明顺序多段、段间空行分隔，JSON 为成员名到行数组的对象映射。`summary` 与 `heatmap` 仍无行 schema、不可导出；未知视图以动态允许集合（内置视图加已配置名）拒绝。
- `compare 202607 202608`。双位置参数按时间先后对比——早者为基线、参数顺序不影响结果——且年可作为两期之一。双位置参数不可与 `--base` 同用（基线会被确定两次）。
- `top --format json` 与 `forecast --format json`。两者对齐 `export` 的 JSON 合同：原始整数、两空格缩进、尾随换行。`top` 记录含 `rank`、原始值 `client`/`project`/`title`、Unix 毫秒时间戳 `first_ts`/`last_ts` 与 `duration_ms`、全部七项指标（`requests`、`fresh_input`、`output`、`cache_read`、`cache_create`、`reasoning`、`total`）；`forecast` 含 `today_so_far`、两个回看 `windows` 与 `projections`（无数据的窗口不产出预测；全库无数据时 `projections` 为 `[]`）。
- 版本显示归一。本地构建或 `go install` 伪版本显示为 `vX.Y.Z-dev`（基版本指示该检出走向的版本；`commit` 行保留精确修订），`build_time` 按本机时区渲染，`update --force` 在字面 `dev` 之外同样接受归一化的 dev 显示形态。归一化 dev 形态要求基版本语义合法——解析失败的版本串不会被误判为 dev 构建。

### 修复
- Codex 会话标题。此前 Codex App 与 CLI 会话的 Title 恒为空：标题真源是 Codex state DB（`threads.title`），且携带空标题的 upsert 不再覆盖已有值。存量会话执行一次 `token-usage collect all` 即可回补。
- Claude 会话标题。JSONL 自定义标题行的载荷字段名已漂移为驼峰（`customTitle`），而采集器只读旧 kebab 形态，标题因此从未解析到；现在两种形态归一（同现时驼峰优先；同一文件内最后非空值优先）。同样以 `collect all` 回补；源文件不含标题行的会话保持为空。
- AutoClaw 会话标题。三级降级链采集标题：客户端 LocalStorage 显示名（只读 LevelDB 访问，经 sessions.json 桥接）、cron 会话 `label`、再由会话首条有效用户消息派生。AutoClaw 存量会话在下一次 daemon 重启时自动回补。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
